tasks.label: kill-port-8000
args: $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if($conn) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Killed process on port 8000' } else { Write-Host 'Port 8000 is free' }
